# Formatting leftovers in human vs machine texts (generated by `python -m src.artifacts` from data/processed/m4_en.parquet)

Share of texts that contain each pattern at least once. Regexes are in `src/artifacts.py`.

| pattern | human | machine | human / machine |
|---|---|---|---|
| references | 21.6% | 1.5% | 14.3× |
| external links | 11.1% | 0.2% | 56.9× |
| see also | 6.0% | 0.3% | 17.9× |
| _URL_N_ | 8.9% | 0.0% | ∞ |
| '. ,' (stray comma) | 19.6% | 0.3% | 65.2× |
| ',,' (double comma) | 12.1% | 0.1% | 201.1× |
| '<year> births' | 6.0% | 0.1% | 83.3× |
| LaTeX math '$...$' | 7.5% | 3.2% | 2.4× |
| any page leftover (all above except LaTeX) | 51.1% | 2.1% | 24.2× |
